audit.summary: The 320x480 ad shows a carousel carousel that rotates product offerings. The initial/animated states display a camping tent promotion, while the settled state shows a premium drawing kit. Critical issues: (1) Bottom safe margin violated – the primary CTA button "Voir toutes les offres" has insufficient clearance from the ad frame bottom edge (appears to be <20px). (2) The yellow underline above the CTA is visually prominent but extends full-width, creating a heavy visual split. (3) Minor typography and spacing inconsistencies across carousel states. (4) Product image quality is acceptable but the layout shift between initial and settled states is jarring.

findings.issue: Primary CTA button "Voir toutes les offres" does not maintain 20px safe inset from bottom edge of #ad-320x480. Visual measurement shows CTA bottom margin is <20px from frame edge.
findings.fix_hint: Add padding-bottom: 20px to #ad-320x480, or set margin-bottom: 20px on .cta-button. Ensure .cta-button and parent container layout reserves at least 20px clear space below the button inside the 480px frame height.

findings.issue: Yellow horizontal divider line above CTA button (border-top) creates visual imbalance and excessive whitespace split. The line is too heavy for the layout proportions on a 320x480 mobile canvas.
findings.fix_hint: Reduce border-top height from current thickness to 2px (or 3px max), or change from solid yellow (#FFF000) to a 1px underline on the product price/description section instead. Consider margin-bottom on divider to tighten spacing.

findings.issue: Carousel dot indicators (pagination bullets) are small and may be difficult to tap on mobile touch. Current visual size appears to be ~8-10px diameter.
findings.fix_hint: Increase hit target of carousel dots to 44px minimum (recommend 48px) by adding padding or wrapper. Current .carousel-dots li should have padding: 12px or wrapping in a larger touch target zone. Visual size can remain 8-10px but touch area must be ≥44px.

findings.issue: Layout shift between initial/animated and settled carousel states is visually jarring – product image size and position change significantly, and the text layout reflows. Consider smoothing the transition.
findings.fix_hint: Apply CSS transition: transform 0.3s ease, opacity 0.3s ease to carousel items. Ensure image container has fixed aspect ratio (e.g., aspect-ratio: 16/9) or set height: 180px explicitly so layout does not shift. Add will-change: transform to carousel items for performance.

audit.regeneration_prompt:
Patch instructions for 320x480 ad:
1. Add padding-bottom: 20px to #ad-320x480 (or margin-bottom: 20px on .cta-button) to enforce 20px safe inset from frame bottom.
2. Reduce yellow border-top above CTA from current thickness to 2px solid #FFF000, or move divider to price section and adjust margin-bottom: 8px.
3. Increase carousel dot touch targets: wrap .carousel-dots li in a 48px×48px padding container or add padding: 12px per dot.
4. Set fixed height: 180px or aspect-ratio: 16/9 on carousel image container to prevent layout shift; add transition: transform 0.3s ease, opacity 0.3s ease to carousel items.
